title: Data Story
style: A dark dashboard: a grid of rounded widgets on graphite, each animating its own data (a switch, a bar chart that re-sorts, a count-up percentage, a donut, a line chart that draws on, a live blob). Numbers roll like odometers. Coral accent for the headline figure, mint for good news.
learnsFrom: UI and data-viz moments in code-made reels: a grid of widgets that animate together, numbers that count up, charts that draw on.

story.what: hook: the grid assembles, each widget springing in from its corner on a stagger; the big number reads 0%
'Meetings found this week': the headline figure counts up to 92% while a bar chart of the weekdays rises
a switch turns on ('Auto-book'), the bars re-sort from most to least free, and the figure climbs to 98%
a line chart of 'hours saved' draws on with a dot riding its head; a donut fills to 3 of 4 teams
the camera pushes into the headline widget until 98% fills the frame
sign-off: 'Oriel' with 'hours given back' and the figure '14 h' in mint

sizes: Vertical stacks the widgets in one column with the headline figure on top, larger.
sound: beatScore drive at 120 bpm with ticks as numbers roll, a hit on the switch and on 98%, and the sign-off under the name.
teaches: Data motion is honest when numbers move with the shapes that show them: every figure tweens from the same clock as its chart.

portable.fonts: Inter (400, 600, 800 with tabular numbers) and JetBrains Mono
portable.style: A dark dashboard: a grid of rounded widgets on graphite, each animating its own data (a switch, a bar chart that re-sorts, a count-up percentage, a donut, a line chart that draws on, a live blob). Numbers roll like odometers. A coral accent for the headline figure and mint for good news. All data is invented and fixed, so every render is the same.
